name: Ovex ChromeFit Adaptive Legging
description: High-waisted compression leggings in deep navy with segmented stretch zones engineered around the geometry of prosthetic and augmented legs — wider at the joint housings, slimmer at the shafts, with a smooth outer surface that doesn't bunch at chrome edges. Designed to be worn over partial aug coverage or under outer pants as a liner. A small embossed Ovex wordmark sits at the hip.
functionality: Segmented stretch geometry accommodates standard aug limb profiles without bunching or pressure points. Works as both outerwear and liner.
what_it_says: You've invested in dressing cleanly around your augmentation.
worn_by: aug users who want a streamlined look
story_hooks: A runner who uses these as a liner layer has her aug's heat signature partially masked by the microfiber — unintentionally.
A counterfeit version is circulating that doesn't have the segmented zones; it tears at chrome edges within a week.
